limitation_carry_forward.name: local_transmission_hosting_capacity
limitation_carry_forward.title: Local transmission hosting capacity
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle stages a regional NERC reserve-margin headroom overlay as a coarse hosting-capacity proxy, but it still does not model local transmission hosting-capacity headroom.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: The hosting overlay supports coarse regional screening only; it does not confirm local deliverability or interconnection feasibility.

limitation_carry_forward.name: demand_queue_times
limitation_carry_forward.title: Demand queue times
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle does not model interconnection queue wait times or developer queue backlog.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: Report outputs do not imply deployment-ready timing or queue-adjusted build schedules.

limitation_carry_forward.name: zoning_information
limitation_carry_forward.title: Zoning information
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle stages an NLCD developed-land context overlay as a coarse zoning proxy, but it still does not model parcel-level zoning or allowed land uses.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: The zoning overlay supports coarse developed-context screening only; it does not confirm parcel-level zoning approval or data-center entitlement.

limitation_carry_forward.name: permitting_and_ordinance_information
limitation_carry_forward.title: Permitting and ordinance information
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle does not model local permitting pathways or ordinance restrictions.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: Report outputs do not imply permit readiness or ordinance compatibility.

limitation_carry_forward.name: capacity_scaling_by_market_trends
limitation_carry_forward.title: More representative capacity scaling by market trends
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle uses public EER scenario inputs and smoke-config site-addition limits rather than market-specific capacity scaling.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: Cumulative buildout outputs are screening artifacts, not market-calibrated deployment forecasts.

limitation_carry_forward.name: social_acceptance
limitation_carry_forward.title: Social acceptance
limitation_carry_forward.current_posture: The current bundle does not model community acceptance, local opposition, or related siting friction.
limitation_carry_forward.output_implication: Ranked outputs do not account for local acceptance risk.
